dekoruma.valuation_parent_note: Blibli bought 99.83% for Rp 1.16T in Jun 2024, so the purchase price sits inside Blibli's market capitalisation, already counted on Blibli's row.

ovo.valuation_parent_note: Grab owns ~90% of PT Visionet Internasional and consolidates it, so OVO's value sits inside Grab's market capitalisation — and therefore inside the Indonesia-only carve-out counted on the Grab Indonesia row. The US$2.9B here is OVO's own 2019 unicorn mark, from before Grab took control; it is kept on the row as the last standalone price and held out of the sum.

ranch-market.valuation_parent_note: Blibli (IDX: BELI) has held 51.00% since 30 Sep 2021 and consolidates Supra Boga Lestari as a direct subsidiary (BELI's audited FY2025 statements), so the majority of this Rp 813.5bn live market cap already sits inside Blibli's own — counting both would double-count. The RANC cap is kept on the row and held out of the sum.

tiket-com.valuation_parent_note: Blibli (IDX: BELI) has owned 100% since 12 Jun 2017. The figure on this row is an estimated carve-out of the same market capitalisation counted on Blibli's row.
